heading: Our Story
lead: Led by a professionally trained chef and baker, Uncle Mimi's Kitchen makes everything fresh and local here on Martha's Vineyard.
paragraphs: Tammy started baking out of her kitchen in Chilmark and is happy to share her love of delicious breads and baked goods with all of you. Our small-batch, artisanal products are made with the highest-quality ingredients — and we hope you enjoy every bite!

We often are asked about the name and its origins. As a toddler, Tammy's nephew called her “Mimi” and lovingly assumed both she and her husband were uncles. His favorite place to eat, he insisted, was “Uncle Mimi's Restaurant” — and it still is today.

sign.alt: The original hand-lettered “Uncle Mimi's Restaurant” sign, painted on a weathered wooden plank resting against a stone wall in the grass.
